product_overview: Unison Search provides a unified full-text and structured search across organizational facets (datasets, systems, people, glossary, processes) with a query builder, filters, org-unit scoping, history, and tabular or dashboard result views.
core_goals: Search across multiple business facets (datasets, systems, people, glossary, processes) using a single query surface.
Build compound queries using logical operators (FIND, AND, OR, NOT) and a visual query builder.
Narrow and scope results using facet filters, hierarchical filters, and org unit selection.
Browse results in a sortable, paginated table or switch to a dashboard view with charts summarizing results.
Recall and re-run prior queries via search history for faster repeat investigations.

features.name: Unison Search
features.description: Run unified full-text and structured searches across configurable facets, build multi-condition queries, apply filters and org-unit scoping, and view results as a list or dashboard.
user_flows: Open /search.html -> Choose FIND operator from search type select -> Type keywords in the main search input -> Click SEARCH to run the query -> See results displayed in the list table
Open /search.html with ?q=<text> in the URL -> See the main search input prefilled and search auto-triggered after load -> See results displayed in the list table
Open /search.html -> Select a category from the sidebar to set the facet -> Type keywords in the main search input -> Click SEARCH to run the query -> See results for the selected facet in the table

Open /search.html -> Select a category from the sidebar -> Open the filter panel -> Add a filter row and set filter criteria -> Apply filters -> See the results table update to reflect applied filters

Open /search.html -> Use Org Unit dropdown to choose an org unit to scope results -> Type keywords in the main search input -> Click SEARCH to run the query -> See results scoped to the chosen org unit

Open /search.html -> Open the History dropdown -> Select a prior query from history -> See the prior query loaded into the main search input -> Click SEARCH to run the loaded query -> See results matching the historical query
Open /search.html -> Run a search that returns results -> Switch view to dashboard -> See charts summarizing the current search results

Open /search.html -> Use the query builder to add multiple conditions until the condition counter is visible -> Choose logical operators (AND/OR/NOT) between conditions -> Click SEARCH to run the compound query -> See results matching the compound query
Open /search.html -> Ensure no category is selected and leave the search input empty -> Click SEARCH -> See a message prompting to select a category before viewing results

routes.description: Unison cross-facet search UI with filters, categories, and results table

features.name: Unison Search
features.description: Full-text and structured search across business facets (datasets, systems, glossary, processes, etc.) with query builder, org unit scoping, filters, history, and tabular results.

Choose FIND / AND / OR / NOT operator from search type select
Type keywords in the main search input
Click SEARCH to run the query
Open Filter panel, adjust facet filters, apply or clear

Use History dropdown for prior queries
Use category sidebar to switch result facets
Interact with results table (sort, pagination, row actions as exposed in UI)
Use Clear and query builder (condition counter) when building multi-part queries

known_limitations.issue: Search API uses credentials include; unauthenticated users receive 403 from APIs even if the HTML loads
known_limitations.impact: Automated tests need a valid session or test account to validate full search flow
